name: the-dental-hauz-website
description: Static website for The Dental Hauz

scripts.test: npm run lint:html && npm run test:e2e && npm run theme:php && npm run theme:render && npm run theme:complete && npm run theme:e2e
scripts.theme:render: rm -rf tests/theme/out && mkdir -p tests/theme/out && cp -r wordpress-theme/the-dental-hauz/style.css wordpress-theme/the-dental-hauz/assets tests/theme/out/ && echo placeholder > tests/theme/out/assets/video.mp4 && DH_THEME_DIR=$PWD/wordpress-theme/the-dental-hauz php tests/theme/render.php tests/theme/out
scripts.theme:php: for f in $(find wordpress-theme -name '*.php'); do php -l $f >/dev/null || exit 1; done && DH_THEME_DIR=$PWD/wordpress-theme/the-dental-hauz php tests/theme/forms-test.php
